reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-10-10T23:32:24Z: the October 8, 2026 holdings CSV publishes eleven Treasury bills with market value USD 31,981,618.61 and four overnight Treasury repos totaling USD 18,000,000, for USD 49,981,618.61 total listed securities. Both slice weights use these published market values without favourable rounding or substituting par percentages. Repo counterparties are J.P. Morgan Securities (USD 7m), Credit Agricole CIB (USD 5m), BofA Securities (USD 5m) and Mizuho Securities USA (USD 1m), with October 9 maturities. Bills mature October 13 through December 24, 2026; the 93-day maximum remains the prospectus mandate, not WAM. The listed-securities denominator is not represented as current whole-token liabilities or total fund net assets; no collateralization ratio, financial assurance, account-level custody or executable redemption capacity is inferred.
